notes.note: Sheezel exited the game in the second term after a head clash with what could be some structural damage around his left eye. He is highly unlikely to play this week.
Sheezel got off to a hot start but just 31 points in the second half for him saw his first sub 100 since round 13 with his 29 disposals coming at just 62%.
Sheezel was the best of the Roos as usual with 2 goals from his 25 disposals (at 92% efficiency). He is always a C or VC option for us.
Sheezel was just the complete player as we are used to. He ended with 29 at an incredible 93% efficiency with a goal. He is a must consider for C every week.
Sheezel had another huge day with 33 touches 6 marks and a goal. He is a captain option for you almost every week.
Sheezel had a big first quarter but after that did slow down ending with 28 disposals and 9 tackles.
Sheezel was massive with his 40 disposals 9 tackles and goal. He is having a great run of scoring and hasn't been below 140 in the last four games.
That�s now three huge scores for Sheezel in a row with 43 disposals and 12 marks this week. He has been a permanent captain option for us. He should be good again this week against Port.
Sheezel was huge with 31 disposals and 5 clearances. This makes it two over 140 in a row now as he really shows how good he can be.
Sheezel put in a huge game as he led the game disposals with 33 and Contested possessions 15 and Clearances with 10. He dined out on the Eagles to post a third score over 140 for the year.
Sheezel hasn't strung two scores over 100 together now since rounds 5 and 6. His 27 disposals this week gained just 187m.
Sheezel was back to his old self this week with 32 disposals and 6 tackles to be the second highest scorer for the Roos.
Sheezel had his third sub 100 in the last four an it was also his lowest of the season. The Roos were never really in the contest which really hurt his score.
Sheezel got his first over 100 for the last three weeks.31 disposals and a goal and a game high 7 tackles.
Sheezel got the tag from Mullin but he still managed his 20 disposals and goal. This was his lowest for the year however and is now two under 100 in a row. Look for him to bounce back next week.
We were worried with his finger injury but he played and it didn't impact him too much with 32 disposals and a goal.
Sheezel did Sheezel things with another massive score. 39 disposals to go with 8 marks and 7 clearances. He is a VC or C option for you every week.
30 disposals this week for Sheezel with another 120+ score. Great bounce back after last week. Always an option for your C or VC.
Sheezel didn't put up a huge score like many thought he might with his 24 disposals and a goal. He made the BE this week but his price will start to drop so non owners keep a watch on him.
Sheezel again went big and is a perma captain option for us this season. 11 marks and 33 disposals at 87% is fantastic in any language.
Sheezel was on a hot pace but that did slow when the Eagles got going. However nothing to worry about with his 40 disposal 8 clearance game.
Sheezel spent time floating between half back and midfield during the game and he scored big as he was allowed to do as he wanted. If you didn't start him look to get him in.
